description: This file is a shell script that provides various subcommands for managing git submodules, including commands to add, initialize, deinitialize, update, set branch, set URL, show status, summarize, synchronize, and process submodules. It defines command functions and parses arguments to perform specific operations related to git submodules.

methods.name: cmd_add
methods.description: Adds a new submodule to the working tree, .gitmodules, and the index, with optional parameters like branch, force, reference, etc.

methods.name: cmd_foreach
methods.description: Executes an arbitrary command in each checked-out submodule.

methods.name: cmd_deinit
methods.description: Unregisters submodules from .git/config and removes their work trees.

methods.name: cmd_update
methods.description: Updates each submodule path to the correct revision, using clone and checkout as needed.

methods.name: cmd_summary
methods.description: Shows commit summaries for submodules in index or working tree.

methods.name: cmd_status
methods.description: Lists all submodules with information about their current state.

methods.name: cmd_sync
methods.description: Synchronizes remote URLs for submodules, matching the values in .gitmodules.

methods.name: cmd_absorbgitdirs
methods.description: Handles absorption of GIT directories in submodules.
